text:
nora (design): quick q  compact usage rows need a way to peek token breakouts without leaving the table. proposing a tiny "Preview" affordance inside the token cell that reveals a 3-line mini-ledger on hover/focus. works for org & project scopes.
chad (frontend): sounds good. perf note: avoid rendering heavy svgs for 300+ rows. plan: placeholder + lazy-hydrate on interaction (mouseenter/focus).
emma (pm): let's AB test hover+focus preview vs explicit Preview button to measure accidental opens. metrics: preview_open_rate, preview_to_invoice_click, preview_qps.
liam (infra): backend guardrail: please use per-user LRU cache (TTL 5m) and batch requests when user hovers multiple rows quickly. rate-limit preview endpoint.
sam (a11y): accessibility: preview must be reachable via keyboard. include a small button with aria-controls -> preview id and aria-expanded toggled. add visually-hidden summary with id=preview-summary-{row}.
nora (design): copy note: preview header = "Token breakdown  last 30 days". button label = "Preview". don't surface full invoice link in inline preview; put "View invoice" in the persistent drawer.
chad (frontend): keyboard flow: Tab -> Preview button -> Enter opens inline panel -> Esc closes and returns focus to the button. If user opens drawer, trap focus. honor prefers-reduced-motion.
emma (pm): experiment setup: cohort A hover+focus preview, cohort B explicit button only. include method in analytics payload.
liam (infra): estimate infra work: batching + per-user cache + rate limits ~ 1 day. chad?
chad (frontend): dev estimate: 3 days (preview-shell, lazy hydrating sparklines, feature flag, analytics).
ci-bot: :white_check_mark: staging smoke passed 2026-03-24T08:41Z
emma (pm): action items: nora update figma frames and microcopy, chad open feature branch, liam add throttle rules, sam write a11y checklist. we'll run small % rollout after smoke.
nora (design): thanks all  i'll post updated frames here later today :sparkles:
